title: Make a quiz
summary: Makes a Quiznect quiz on a topic with the model the agent runs on (the chosen cloud model, or Apple's on-device model) and saves it in the Quiznect applet.
whenToUse: Use when the person asks for a quiz, to be quizzed or tested on a topic.

arguments.name: topic
arguments.description: The topic, such as 'the solar system'

example: Make me a quiz on the solar system
_note: Phase AV.22 (2026-11-12): the Quiznect applet for the agent, through its own service.
